import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Clean Sleep Disorder column
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Extract systolic blood pressure
df['Systolic BP'] = df['Blood Pressure'].apply(lambda x: int(x.split('/')[0]))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("Set2")

# 1. Sleep Duration by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
bmi_sleep = df.groupby('BMI Category')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
bars1 = ax1.bar(bmi_sleep.index, bmi_sleep.values, color=colors[:len(bmi_sleep)])
ax1.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax1.set_ylabel('Avg Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration by BMI Category')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Physical Activity Level'], cmap='RdYlGn', 
                      s=100, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Stress Level')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Physical Activity Level')

# 3. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.0f%%', colors=colors[:len(disorder_counts)],
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(disorder_counts))
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution')

# 4. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Occupation
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
occupation_colors = {occ: colors[i] for i, occ in enumerate(df['Occupation'].unique())}
for occ in df['Occupation'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Occupation'] == occ]
    ax4.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Daily Steps'], 
                label=occ, s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps')
ax4.legend(fontsize=8, loc='best')

# 5. Heart Rate and Blood Pressure by BMI
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
x = range(len(df))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax5.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], df['Heart Rate'], width, label='Heart Rate', color=colors[0])
ax5_twin = ax5.twinx()
bars2 = ax5_twin.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], df['Systolic BP'], width, label='Systolic BP', color=colors[1])
ax5.set_xlabel('Person ID')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', color=colors[0])
ax5_twin.set_ylabel('Systolic BP (mmHg)', color=colors[1])
ax5.set_title('Heart Rate & Blood Pressure by Person')
ax5.set_xticks(x)
ax5.set_xticklabels(df['Person ID'])
ax5.legend(loc='upper left')
ax5_twin.legend(loc='upper right')

# 6. Heatmap of numeric correlations
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
numeric_cols = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            fmt='.2f', ax=ax6, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax6.set_title('Correlation Heatmap')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax6.tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
